package.name: i2rt_vla_bridge
package.description:
Live OpenVLA -> IK -> YAM arm bridge: streams camera frames + a fixed instruction to an OpenVLA inference server, integrates the returned gripper_tip-frame delta action onto the current end-effector pose, solves IK for the arm's existing "arm" MoveIt group via /compute_ik, and streams the result to joint_trajectory_controller + gripper_controller. Publishes a moveit_msgs/DisplayRobotState "ghost" of the next IK-solved step for RViz, alongside the real robot's live pose. See vla_bridge_node.py's module docstring for the full per-tick pipeline and safety model (enable-gate, delta clamps, hold-on-IK-failure).
Python (rclpy), unlike the rest of this repo's ament_cmake/C++ packages - a deliberate exception because the OpenVLA server's wire format (json_numpy-encoded numpy arrays) and the pose-delta math (scipy Rotation) are both far more natural in Python than reimplementing an HTTP client + a numpy-array JSON codec in C++ for no functional benefit.
